# Function isRunner

  * isRunner(obj: unknown): obj is [Runner](../classes/Runner.html)

Type guard to check if an object is an instance of Runner.

#### Parameters

    * obj: unknown

The object to check.

#### Returns obj is [Runner](../classes/Runner.html)

True if the object is an instance of Runner, false otherwise.
